lauren: Quick follow-up on the SDK surface RFC — we need to settle the call-shape for iterators + retry pairing before TS/Go PRs land. Short sync: transport vs SDK responsibilities?

michael: +1. Main tradeoff is a single canonical iterator primitive vs language-specific adapters. Canonical primitive makes tests simpler but can leak async/iter semantics into languages that don't match.

yasmin: For Python I'd prefer a generator-based iterator that yields pages with a `resume_token`. TS wants async iterable; Go prefers a channel/iterator pattern. We should define a canonical wire-level pagination contract so each transport adapter maps cleanly.

kevin: If we keep retries only at the transport layer, languages can't implement higher-level idempotency or resume semantics easily. Proposal: two-layer model — transport handles low-level retries/backoff, SDK composes an "attemptable" wrapper that can replay safe operations (resume tokens).

anita: Concern: exposing too many knobs will confuse users. Keep defaults conservative: auto-retry on idempotent list/get, persist page_token for resume. Advanced controls via ClientOptions or RetryPolicy. :thinking_face:

michael: Sketch of the user-facing shapes:

```
# Python
for page in client.list_items(..., page_size=100):
    for item in page.items:
        process(item)

# TS
for await (const page of client.listItems(...)) {
  page.items.forEach(process)
}
```

Transport should be minimal (HTTP/grpc request -> response). SDK composes iterator + retry semantics.

lauren: Agreed. Concrete next steps: produce a small compatibility matrix mapping Python/TS/Go primitives -> transport contract + a short decision table for where retry/idempotency lives. @kevin @yasmin can you volunteer to draft?

yasmin: I'll take Python + the matrix. I'll also document the resume token field name (`page_token`) and a list of error codes we consider retryable for pagination.

kevin: I'll do TS/Go sketches and a strawman adapter API (adapter.signature + how it exposes resume). Target: end of week.

dev-bot: Created doc: https://redwood/notes/sdk-iterators/171950-draft (private) :white_check_mark:

lauren: Thanks. One more TODO: add a short migration note for older clients about stricter `page_token` semantics and how to opt into legacy behavior. We'll decide default-on vs opt-in in the draft. :memo:
